label: Reply to a legal notice

review.note: Fixed wording is a standard reply format. It has not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate.

notes: Check the time given in the notice you are replying to. If it is a notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, the 15 days run from the date your client received it.

slots.label: Your client's name (the person who received the notice)
Your name, as the advocate replying
Who sent the notice (advocate or party you are replying to)
On whose behalf the notice was sent
Date of the notice you received
Your client's reply. Write one point per line
slots.example:
That no goods were received under invoice no. 2231, and no delivery challan was ever signed by my client.
That the cheque was given as security and not towards any debt.

slots.label: Facts your client admits (optional, one per line)
slots.example: That the cheque bearing no. 004817 was issued from my client's account.

blocks.text: Subject: Reply to your notice dated {{original_notice_date|date}} issued on behalf of {{original_sender}}.
Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, {{client_name}} ("my client"), I reply as follows to your notice dated {{original_notice_date|date}}:
That the contents of your notice are denied, except those expressly admitted below.
That the allegations in your notice are therefore false and misconceived, and no cause of action arises against my client.
That this reply is issued without prejudice to my client's rights and contentions, all of which are reserved, including the right to claim costs.
